note: Adapted from the entry in Fauna Sinica, originally in Chinese; species 367, the soldier, the alate and the worker are recorded, and the values in the measurement table are transcribed as given; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, antennae and labrum pale yellow, thorax, abdomen and legs yellowish brownish white; head, labrum, thorax and abdomen rather densely hairy. Sides of the head nearly parallel, slightly narrowing posteriorly from the middle, narrowest near the posterior end, the posterior margin rather straight with a distinct median concavity; the median suture extending from the posterior end to 1/3–2/5 of the head capsule length, with a short longitudinal stripe on each side of the suture; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arcuate; the frontal gland pore at the anterior 1/5 of the head; labrum elongate, the two anterolateral angles projecting forward as sharp points, the anterior margin slightly concave; the left and right mandibles almost equal in length and asymmetrical, the apex of the left mandible hooked, that of the right mandible slightly hook-shaped; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 or segment 4, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2; postmentum spindle-shaped, projecting from the ventral surface of the head, its maximum width 2 times the minimum; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior part erect, the median notches of the anterior and posterior margins indistinct; tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Measurements: head length including the mandibles 3.40–3.50 (mean 3.44) mm; head length excluding the mandibles 1.60–1.80 (1.72) mm; head width 1.12–1.20 (1.16) mm; head height including the postmentum 0.91–0.99 (0.95) mm; maximum postmental width 0.39–0.44 (0.406) mm; minimum postmental width 0.20–0.22 (0.21) mm; pronotal width 0.65–0.71 (0.68) mm; hind tibia length 1.08–1.15 (1.12) mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, postclypeus brown, labrum pale yellowish brown, antennae brown, pronotum dark brown, legs yellowish brown; head and pronotum covered with short hairs. Measurements: body length excluding the wings 6.52–7.12 (mean 6.92) mm; forewing length 10.31–11.16 (10.70) mm, width 2.98–3.24 (3.11) mm; head length to the labral apex 1.25–1.30 (1.28) mm; head width including the compound eyes 1.12–1.15 (1.13) mm; head width excluding the compound eyes 0.85–0.94 (0.898) mm; compound eye long diameter 0.26–0.27 (0.264) mm, short diameter 0.245–0.26 (0.251) mm; ocellus long diameter 0.08–0.09 (0.086) mm, short diameter 0.055–0.07 (0.0603) mm; ocellus–eye distance 0.06–0.08 (0.069) mm; compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.08–0.095 (0.087) mm; pronotal length 0.46–0.50 (0.482) mm, width 0.90–0.95 (0.932) mm; hind tibia length 1.10–1.16 (1.135) mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head slightly circular, widest at the middle, the lateral margins slightly narrowing posteriorly from the middle, the posterior margin broadly arcuate; T-shaped head suture visible; in lateral view the top of the head flat; postclypeus raised; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3 or about equal, segment 4 shortest and smallest; pronotum saddle-shaped; abdomen olive-shaped, the gut contents visible through the integument. Measurements: head length to the labral apex 1.16–1.31 mm; head width 0.95–1.00 mm; pronotal width 0.54–0.59 mm; hind tibia length 0.84–0.92 mm.
